items.name: okayed-theme
items.title: okayed theme
items.description: Cool neutrals, one cobalt seal accent, semantic allow/ask/deny colours, Shortcuts-style action tiles, and the seal, rise, tick and sheen animations.

items.name: okayed-engine
items.title: okayed engine
items.description: okayed's deterministic policy engine: rules, decisions, narrowing and plain-words explanations. Pure TypeScript, no dependencies.

items.name: okayed-primitives
items.title: okayed primitives
items.description: Action tiles, agent avatars, tokens, the seal, verdict pills and Shortcuts-style steps.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to confirm
items.description: Drag the knob all the way across to confirm; let go early and it springs back. Enter or Space confirms from the keyboard.

items.name: hold-slide
items.title: Hold and slide
items.description: Press and hold, slide up to pick how long (1 hour to always), then slide across to confirm. A tap is still a tap; arrows and Enter work from the keyboard.

items.name: swipe-decide
items.title: Swipe to decide
items.description: Every approval's one gesture: swipe right for the answer it names. Always and Deny are pills to hold (rest on a chip for how long, then slide up and swipe) or tap; without Always, Not now sits at the row's end. The gesture's rules are a pure, tested model.

items.name: done-mark
items.title: Done mark
items.description: A decision settling in: a disc whose tick draws itself, or a quiet cross, with the words beside it.

items.name: money-card
items.title: Money card
items.description: A payment as a wallet card: the amount big, what it's for, how it's paid, and Swipe to pay with Not now. Decided, it folds to a small receipt.

items.name: approval-actions
items.title: Approval actions
items.description: The decisions on an approval card, in a stack or a row, by tap, swipe or hold-and-slide: Allow once, Always allow…, Block… and Don't allow.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: Where it happens, the question in plain words (who, the verb, the exact targets), the agent's reason, details a tap away, and one decision: swipe to decide by default, or any layout and flow from approval-actions, or your own. A payment is a money card.

items.name: receipt-card
items.title: Receipt card
items.description: A signed permission as a ticket: what it allowed, who, how it was okayed, and whether it's still active.

items.name: rule-tile
items.title: Rule tile
items.description: A rule in a library grid, as Shortcuts shows a shortcut, plus the dashed New rule tile.

items.name: rule-editor
items.title: Rule editor
items.description: A Shortcuts-style editor: steps that read as one sentence, every value a token, with a live answer from the engine.

items.name: approval-card-row
items.title: Approval card: one row
items.description: Every decision in one row: Don't allow · Always allow… · Allow once.

items.name: approval-card-swipe
items.title: Approval card: swipe, and hold for how long
items.description: Swipe to allow. Hold Always, rest on 1d, 30d or ∞, then slide up and swipe to make a rule that long; hold Deny to block the same way.

items.name: approval-card-hold
items.title: Approval card: hold and slide
items.description: Hold Always allow… or Block…, slide up to pick how long the rule lasts, then slide across to make it.

items.name: approval-card-pay
items.title: Approval card: a payment
items.description: A purchase asks with a money card: the amount, what it's for, Swipe to pay, Not now.

items.name: okayed
items.title: Everything okayed
items.description: The theme, the engine and every okayed component.
